title: The canned job warning names a typed vendor part by the inactive part's number
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test, with a hyphen in its part number, and an active part, part C.
  • Create a canned job for this test, canned job A, holding part C and a vendor part typed in by hand whose number is part A's number in lower case with periods in place of its hyphens.
  • Set part A inactive after canned job A is saved.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, with no lines.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Line.
  2. Type the start of canned job A's title in the Title field.
  3. Click the canned job A suggestion.
  4. Click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Line window opens.

Step 2:

  • Canned job A is suggested.

Step 3:

  • The canned job A line is filled in.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1's new line holds part C only: the typed vendor part is not on it.
  • One warning shows: "These parts are inactive and were not added:" followed by part A's own part number, with capitals and hyphens, not the number as typed in the canned job.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R9a: “A canned job part that was typed in as a vendor part, and whose number matches an inactive part at this location, is left out too.”
  • Story 9, context note: “Context note: in S9-R9a, S9-R15, S9-R16 and S9-R17 a number "matches" an inactive part when the two are the same once upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored. A number that also belongs to an active part at this location is not refused.”
  • S9-R10: “When a canned job leaves out parts, the system shows one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." The warning stays until the user closes it.”
  • S9-R10b: “The warning names each part by the inventory part's own number, as it shows on the Inactive tab, not by the number as typed in the canned job.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10822 acceptance criteria: “Given a canned job with a vendor part typed by hand as FF5507, and FF-5507 is inactive at this location, when the job is applied, then the part is left out and the warning names it as FF-5507.”
